name: Restart Explorer
description: Restarts Windows Explorer to refresh the desktop, taskbar, Start menu, and File Explorer without restarting your PC. This helps when icons do not update or the interface freezes.

description_i18n.en: Restarts Windows Explorer to refresh the desktop, taskbar, Start menu, and File Explorer without restarting your PC. This helps when icons do not update or the interface freezes.
description_i18n.de: Startet den Windows-Explorer neu, um Desktop, Taskleiste und Datei-Explorer zu aktualisieren, ohne Ihren PC neu zu starten. Hilft bei nicht aktualisierten Symbolen oder eingefrorener Oberfläche.
description_i18n.fr: Redémarre l'Explorateur Windows pour rafraîchir le bureau et la barre des tâches sans redémarrer votre ordinateur. Utile lorsque les icônes ne se mettent pas à jour ou que l'interface gèle.

warnings.title: Explorer refresh
warnings.message: Windows Explorer may close briefly while the desktop, taskbar, and File Explorer are refreshed. Your open windows will remain intact but you must wait a moment for them to reappear

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: The script terminates the explorer.exe process and immediately launches a new instance to restore functionality
